## INPUT ZONE
Lead sources connect here.
Google Maps, Yelp, directories.
Each source runs in parallel.

## PROCESSING ZONE
Normalize, deduplicate, and score.
Every lead gets a 0-100 quality score
before any outreach happens.

## OUTPUT ZONE
Qualified leads (score >= 50) go to
your main sheet for outreach.
Low-priority leads stored separately.

In production: AI outreach + follow-up
workflows connect here.
